leaves.claim: the compound claim as a whole
gauge selftest reproduces locally: 13 checks 0 failures (kill/survive/tamper-chain/genesis-binding)
full gauge reproduces oracle-strength 41/41=100pct, 0 survivors, chain re-derivation byte-IDENTICAL

leaves.note: the mark's own SHORTCUT: catalog is HAND-WRITTEN 42 mutants, not operator-generated from every <,>>,index,constant site; 100pct is 100pct OF THIS CATALOG. the 6 original survivors were closed in tests/test_fused.c but the reference still shares code with the fused path (the mark names this as the root cause). one-compiler assumption for UB mutants.

body.weakest_claim: 100pct generalizes to an arbitrary planted bug (not just these 42)

body.reason: ACCEPT both cells — this is the ONLY fully-independently-verified harvest of the 5.5 wave: I re-ran both selftests + the full gauge on my own clone with my own node22/cc13 and reproduced every number (41/41, 27/27, byte-identical chain). The cells are honest — the mark self-reports the shortcut. Fold isolates the one soft leaf: the 100pct is bounded to a hand-written catalog (0.55), so the score certifies THESE 42 holes are closed, not that the oracle is complete — which is exactly what an oracle-strength score should claim. whole 0.72 blurred a 0.97-verified core against a 0.55 generalization limit; gap -0.17. NEXT (already in the mark): operator-level generator + a reference sharing NO code with the fused path + wire --strict into CI.
